title: Scroll progress
summary: A thin bar at the top of the screen that fills as the page (or a named scroller) is read.

cssProperties.name: --pk-progress
cssProperties.description: Scrolled fraction 0 to 1, set by the element

a11y: Decorative (aria-hidden); the scroll position is already available to assistive tech.
mobile: 3px bar; ignores the safe-area inset because it sits at the top edge of the content.
